description: What a Celestia node operator needs to bootstrap and keep a node healthy, from Unity Nodes Pulse: persistent peers and seeds, snapshot and address-book mirrors, state-sync servers with the current trust height and hash, the auto-upgrade script, the Unity Nodes pruned snapshot with its restore and verify procedure, and the health of public RPC, REST and gRPC endpoints (status, latency, app version). Mainnet or the Mocha testnet. Celestia only, curated lists plus a probe refreshed every 15 minutes. The restore procedure deletes the node data directory: read it before running anything. Endpoint status is what Pulse measured from its own server.
name: get_celestia_operator_toolkit
